_comment: Hero photo slider. Each slide needs "image" (a path under images/, landscape, roughly 16:9) and "alt". NOTE: the homepage hero draws its own headline over every slide, so it renders ONLY image and alt — any heading, text or link here is ignored. Avoid images with type baked into them for the same reason. To add one: drop the file into images/photos/ and add an entry here.
